the opportunity
we are seeking a highly motivated and proactive endpoint performance specialist to join our digital it team. in this fast-paced role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing endpoint management, automation, and performance engineering solutions that enhance the digital employee experience across a global organization. working closely with infrastructure, security, and operations teams, you will drive initiatives focused on endpoint reliability, compliance, security, and operational efficiency through modern device management and automation.
the endpoint performance specialist provides technical expertise, strategic guidance, and operational support as a key member of the digital it team. in partnership with internal stakeholders, you will develop scalable automation solutions, optimize windows endpoint performance, manage intune and security policies, and leverage digital experience insights to deliver a seamless and productive user experience. the ideal candidate will possess strong problem-solving and analytical skills, excellent communication and collaboration abilities, and a passion for automation, continuous improvement, and delivering exceptional technology experiences.

essential duties and responsibilities
endpoint management and automation

 design, develop, and maintain enterprise-scale automation solutions for endpoint provisioning, configuration, remediation, security enforcement, and lifecycle management
 develop advanced powershell and python automation frameworks to reduce manual operational effort and improve service reliability
 build proactive remediation and self-healing solutions using microsoft intune, endpoint analytics, dex platforms, and windows native capabilities
 automate endpoint health checks, compliance validation, software deployment, performance optimization, and security policy enforcement
 integrate automation with microsoft graph api, azure automation, power automate, and other enterprise management platforms
 establish automation standards, governance, code reviews, testing methodologies, and documentation best practices
 identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive operational tasks and drive continuous improvement through automation

performance engineering & troubleshooting

 perform advanced diagnostics for boot/login delays, application slowness, memory/cpu bottlenecks, and storage i/o issues
 utilize tools such as windows performance analyzer (wpa), windows performance recorder (wpr), sysinternals suite, perfmon, procmon, and etw tracing
 define and maintain endpoint performance baselines and implement proactive monitoring strategies
 conduct root cause analysis of recurring endpoint performance issues and recommend long-term solutions

endpoint imaging & deployment automation

 design, maintain, and optimize windows 11 golden images for large-scale enterprise deployment
 automate os and application deployments using intune (autopilot) and azure ad
 develop and maintain powershell scripts for image updates, driver integration, and application packaging
 implement zero-touch provisioning and streamline device onboarding processes

intune & security policy management

 configure and manage intune endpoint policies, compliance rules, and autopilot deployments
 implement and maintain windows defender application control (wdac) policies to enforce application security and compliance without compromising performance
 align endpoint configurations with enterprise security baselines (bitlocker, microsoft defender, cis, and mdm policies)
 collaborate with security teams to ensure balance between performance, optimization, automation, and compliance

digital employee experience (dex) monitoring

 use dex tools (e.g., aternity, nexthink, or equivalent) to monitor user experience, identify performance gaps, and improve endpoint reliability
 analyze telemetry and feedback to drive continuous improvement in end-user productivity and satisfaction
 integrate dex insights with automation to create proactive remediation and self-healing solutions

requirements
minimum qualifications

 4–6 years of experience in windows endpoint engineering, automation, imaging, and performance optimization
 strong expertise in windows 11 internals (boot process, registry, kernel processes, os servicing)
 hands-on experience with microsoft intune (autopilot, endpoint security, compliance, analytics)
 proven experience implementing and managing windows defender application control (wdac)
 strong automation engineering experience with powershell scripting, microsoft graph api, intune automation, proactive remediations, and endpoint self-healing solutions
 ability to design scalable automation frameworks and eliminate manual operational processes
 proficiency in automation and scripting (powershell required; python preferred)
 skilled in using performance diagnostics tools (wpa, wpr, sysinternals, procmon, etw, perfmon)
 working knowledge of active directory, group policy, azure ad, and hybrid identity models
 familiarity with dex tools for endpoint experience monitoring

preferred qualifications

 experience with azure automation, power automate, logic apps, graph api, and automation orchestration platforms
 experience with application packaging and distribution
 exposure to endpoint ci/cd pipelines (azure devops, github actions)
 understanding of network performance tuning for endpoints
 knowledge of vdi/avd environments and windows 11 performance in virtualized contexts

firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway. join systra canada in shaping the future of canada with this impressive alto high-speed rail project connecting quebec city to toronto, the largest infrastructure project in canada in generations. the alto high-speed rail project aims to improve the quality of life of our citizens, strengthen ties between communities, and stimulate economic growth. are you convinced that a more sustainable world is possible and that mobility is an integral part of thinking about the future of our planet? come aboard with systra canada and be part of the project that will revolutionize the railway industry in canada! as part of the gis team supporting the alto project, the cartography coordinator and qa is responsible for coordinating the production of high-quality cartographic deliverables and ensuring consistency, accuracy, and visual excellence across all map products. this role supports consultation, analysis, and decision-making for major transportation infrastructure projects by combining advanced cartographic expertise with quality assurance oversight, template standardization, and close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams. the successful candidate will lead the development and application of cartographic standards, oversee the review and quality control of map outputs, and produce clear, visually effective thematic and analytical maps for internal teams, clients, and public-facing initiatives. the role is primarily based in arcgis pro, with data accessed and shared through arcgis enterprise. key responsibilities design and produce high-quality thematic, analytical, and presentation-ready maps in arcgis pro to support consultation activities, corridor analyses, environmental studies, infrastructure planning, and project decision-making. coordinate cartographic production activities across the gis team by organizing priorities, supporting deliverable planning, and helping ensure that mapping outputs are produced on time and according to project standards. establish, maintain, and enforce cartographic standards, including symbology libraries, layout templates, labeling conventions, map series configurations, and graphic representation rules tailored to various audiences, including internal teams, clients, and public consultation groups. lead the quality assurance and quality control review of cartographic outputs by verifying map accuracy, legend content, scale, projection, symbology, formatting, metadata, bilingual content, and overall visual consistency before publication or distribution. ensure map readability, usability, and visual quality by applying sound cartographic design principles, including colour theory, typography, visual hierarchy, balance, and accessibility considerations. access, organize, and prepare spatial data from the project’s arcgis enterprise environment and other sources, including cad, gis, tabular, and remote sensing datasets, and convert or format data as needed for cartographic production. perform basic spatial data preparation tasks such as coordinate system transformations, georeferencing, format conversion, and data cleanup to support accurate and efficient map creation. work closely with gis analysts, engineers, planners, environmental specialists, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, translate technical information into clear visual products, and ensure deliverables meet both technical and communication objectives. publish finalized cartographic products through arcgis enterprise and support the integration of approved map content into web-based applications such as experience builder and arcgis dashboards when required. contribute to the continuous improvement of cartographic workflows, review processes, and production efficiency by identifying opportunities to standardize practices and improve output quality. provide guidance and support to team members on cartographic best practices, map standards, and quality expectations. communicate effectively in both english and french with internal teams, project stakeholders, and clients. education: • diploma or bachelor’s degree in geography, cartography, gis, geomatics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. years of experience: 7 to 10 years of professional experience in cartographic production, gis mapping, thematic map creation, or a related role. experience in transportation or infrastructure projects is considered a strong asset. technical competencies: advanced proficiency in arcgis pro for thematic mapping, layout design, cartographic styling, annotation, labeling, and map production. good working knowledge of arcgis enterprise and/or arcgis online for accessing data, sharing layers, and supporting collaboration across teams. demonstrated experience creating and managing cartographic templates, symbology libraries, layout standards, and map production workflows. strong experience working with data from multiple formats, including cad, gis, tabular, and remote sensing sources, and preparing those datasets for cartographic use. strong understanding of cartographic design principles, including colour usage, typography, readability, composition, and visual hierarchy. experience reviewing and validating cartographic outputs to ensure compliance with established technical and visual standards. clear verbal and written communication skills, both in french and in english* *reasons for requiring bilingualism: you will have the opportunity to work with a varied clientele, including both french- and english-speaking companies. bilingualism is therefore fundamental to building strong relationships with our customers, understanding their specific needs, communicating effectively in their preferred language and facilitating strategic meetings. personal & soft skills: excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deliverables under tight deadlines. strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. systra canada is committed to having a diverse ************************************************************* amazon web services (aws) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for a logistics specialist to join our expanding infrastructure founded by yoshua bengio, lawzero is a nonprofit organization focused on ai safety. in charge of technology, the it department oversees cybersecurity, end user support, and the management of the compute environment used to achieve our mission. you will own the platform layer that sits between our people and the gpu infrastructure: ci/cd pipelines, kubernetes clusters, cloud environments, and the standards that keep them consistent and secure. this is a hands-on role on a small it team, with a wide surface area and a lot of room to shape how things are built. key responsibilities design, deploy, and run kubernetes clusters for research workloads, including autoscaling, network policies, and workload isolation, both on-premise and in the cloud. define, communicate, and enforce best practices for ci/cd pipelines: automated builds, tests, container image creation, and deployments, with security scanning and provenance built into the pipeline rather than bolted on. implement and manage internal services supporting our research and data teams, providing them with a reliable, secure platform. examples include artifacts registry, container registries, etc. manage our cloud environments as code (terraform or equivalent): accounts, networking, identity, secrets, and cost visibility. define and champion platform standards. base images, deployment patterns, environment promotion, so researchers and engineers ship without reinventing the plumbing each time. work at the boundary between kubernetes and our hpc cluster: containerized workflows that need to interface with the ones running on slurm, shared storage access, and tooling that makes both environments feel coherent to a researcher. build observability into the platform: metrics, logs, traces, and alerts that make failures obvious and debugging quick. we currently use prometheus and grafana. embed security controls into everything above: least-privilege iam, secrets management, supply-chain integrity for dependencies and images, network segmentation, and audit trails. document what you build and automate what you repeat. reduce the number of things that only work because one person remembers how. participate in incident response for platform services, and in the post-incident work that keeps the same problem from recurring. skills and qualifications experience 3–5 years in platform engineering, devops, sre, or a closely related infrastructure role. production experience with kubernetes. not just deploying to it, but operating it: upgrades, rbac, networking, storage, troubleshooting a cluster that is misbehaving. solid ci/cd experience with a modern toolchain (github actions, gitlab ci, jenkins, or similar), including building pipelines from scratch. experience architecting, deploying, and maintaining a gitops workflow is an asset. hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (aws, gcp, or azure) and infrastructure as code. familiarity with on-premise infrastructure is a plus. strong linux fundamentals and comfort with a scripting or programming language such as python, go, or bash. working knowledge of containers beyond the basics: image layering, registries, runtime security, minimal base images. fluency in written and spoken english, french is a strong asset. experience supporting ml or research workloads: gpu scheduling, distributed training, large datasets, high-throughput storage is an asset. security mindset this matters as much as the technical checklist. we are looking for someone who: thinks about the blast radius of a change before making it, and about who could abuse an access path that was opened for convenience. treats secrets, credentials, and access as first-class design concerns rather than afterthoughts. understands supply-chain risk in a build pipeline: dependency provenance, image signing, artifact integrity, what a compromised runner could reach. applies least privilege by default and can explain to a researcher why a control exists, without being obstructive about it. has practical familiarity with identity and access management, network segmentation, and secure defaults in cloud environments. ways of working comfortable being the person who owns a domain end to end in a small team, without a large org to hand things off to. able to work with researchers whose priorities are speed and flexibility, and find solutions that are both secure and genuinely usable. clear written communication. you will write documentation and design notes that others depend on. capable of managing multiple priorities and adjusting to a frequently changing environment. what we offer the opportunity to contribute to a unique mission with a major impact comprehensive health benefits a minimum of 20 days vacation per year upon start a minimum retirement savings employer contribution of 4% generous flexible benefits designed to contribute to your well-being a team of passionate experts in their field a collaborative and inclusive work environment with offices in the heart of little italy, in the trendy mile-ex district, close to public transportation about lawzero lawzero is a non-profit organization committed to advancing research and creating technical solutions that enable safe-by-design ai systems. its scientific direction is based on new research and methods proposed by professor yoshua bengio, the most cited ai researcher in the world. based in montreal, lawzero’s research aims to build non-agentic ai that learns primarily to understand the world rather than to act in it, giving truthful answers to questions based on transparent and externalized probabilistic reasoning. such ai systems could be used to accelerate scientific discovery, to provide oversight for agentic ai systems, and to advance the understanding of ai risks and how to avoid them. lawzero believes that ai should be cultivated as a global public good—developed and used safely towards human flourishing. for more information, visit www.lawzero.org you belong here at lawzero, diversity is important to us. we value a work environment that is fair, open and respectful of differences. we welcome applications from highly qualified individuals interested in working towards our mission in a respectful, inclusive and collaborative setting. your personal information will be collected and processed by lawzero to evaluate your application for employment in compliance with our . under privacy laws in force in your country of residence, you may have several privacy rights, such as to request access to your personal information or to request that your personal information be rectified or erased. details on how you can exercise your rights can be found in our privacy policy.

join the aim team, a growing team that, over the years, has transformed into a multifaceted company with business divisions that include metal recycling, construction waste recycling, weldment fabrication, demolition and dismantling, and auto recycling. we pride ourselves on doing good for the environment to help create a greener, more sustainable future for everyone. it's simple: we do it right. we strive for excellence. job description the specialist bridges the gap between operational asset maintenance and database integrity. he will be the sole custodian of the enterprise asset management platform (such as ibm maximo) inventory catalog, ensuring that every sku, bill of materials (bom), and material asset attribute is precisely maintained. concurrently, he will leverage consumption analytics to design, adjust, and optimize demand planning profiles, ensuring our industrial operations never stall due to a missing component, while keeping working capital lean. what you're responsible for: 1. ibm maximo item master data governance (50%) catalog administration: direct the full lifecycle (creation, validation, modification, and archiving) of inventory sku numbers across a multi-site environment. standardization & structure: enforce strict naming conventions, asset hierarchies, unit of measure (uom) conversions, min-eoq, and commodity classifications for all spares, wear parts, and metal categories. bom maintenance: build and audit bill of materials (boms) and rotating item links within maximo to cleanly map components back to specific shredders, shears, and heavy fleets. data cleansing: run routine data-quality audits to eliminate duplicate entries, correct description irregularities, and ensure vendor cross-references are pristine. 2. inventory analytics & demand planning (50%) replenishment parameters: compute and adjust optimal reorder points (rop), safety stock volumes, and min/max levels inside enterprise asset management platform (such as ibm maximo) based on lead times and seasonal volume fluctuations. maintenance synchronization: partner closely with maintenance planners and engineering to forecast critical spare parts demand ahead of scheduled major overhauls or plant shutdowns. reorder process ownership: own the end-to-end enterprise asset management platform (such as ibm maximo) automated reorder process; generate, validate, and approve systemic replenishment requests (prs) based on system-generated triggers before routing to purchasing groups. performance kpi tracking: track and report on key supply chain metrics including inventory turnover, dead-stock ratios, and stock-out frequencies. process optimization: identify cost-saving opportunities by uncovering slow-moving, obsolete, or duplicate items across interconnected regional warehouses. qualifications to join our team: experience: 3–5 years of dedicated supply chain experience, with at least 2 years focused on inventory/item modules and good erp understanding. industry background: prior experience in asset-intensive environments like metal recycling, heavy manufacturing, mining, production or heavy industrial logistics. technical mindset: advanced proficiency in microsoft excel (vlookups, power query, pivot tables) ms access, ms vba coding & sql to extract and automate, filter, and prepare large inventory data sets for system uploads. education: bachelor’s degree or professional college diploma in supply chain management, operations logistics, data analytics, or a related field. soft skills: exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to confidently negotiate priorities between data standards and urgent business needs. additional information what we offer: competitive salary and benefits group insurance and registered retirement savings plan (rrsp) company activities throughout the year (barbecue, christmas party, etc.) free on-site gym two on-site cafeterias (subsidized meal program available) dynamic and stimulating work environment: work on important and rewarding projects in a friendly atmosphere!

job descriptionjob descriptioncompany description for over 40 years, lgi has built software that healthcare organizations depend on. ai is now at the heart of that work, not as a destination, but as the engine behind our next generation of mission-critical solutions and our enduring mission: helping healthcare organizations perform at their best. we're looking for exceptional people who are passionate about technology, relentless in their standards, and driven to push what's possible further.  at lgi, curiosity isn't a nice-to-have, it's how we work. we're looking for talent who explore and innovate by instinct and want their work to matter beyond the codebase, shaping decisions, enhancing processes, and enabling healthcare practitioners. job description the solutions architect designs the end-to-end architecture required to deploy and operate our solutions successfully in each client’s production environment. this includes infrastructure, cloud and hybrid platforms, integrations, systems, networks, databases, security, observability, and site reliability engineering (sre). the role spans the full client lifecycle. during the bid and pre-sales stages, the solutions architect defines the target architecture and technical requirements, evaluates total cost of ownership (tco), and partners with sales to develop the statement of work (sow). during implementation and operation, they guide technical delivery and remain accountable for the solution’s availability, performance, scalability, and reliability. this is a hands-on position for someone who is equally comfortable making high-impact architecture decisions and investigating traces, query plans, or network traffic during a production incident. as the technical authority and ultimate escalation point for solution architecture, this person works closely with clients, support, monitoring, devops, sre, product architecture, and r&d. the position reports to the customer delivery & performance engineering group. the people who thrive here are relentless in solving problems others have not cracked. they follow the evidence wherever it leads, make sound decisions despite uncertainty, and favour delivering practical, measurable improvements over waiting for a perfect solution that arrives too late. they believe real-world feedback is one of the fastest ways to improve quality. bilingualism in french and english is mandatory , as the position involves working with technical documentation and communicating with french- and english-speaking clients, partners, and colleagues. what you will do design the client-specific production architecture across infrastructure, cloud and hybrid platforms, systems, networks, integrations, databases, security, and observability. size and optimize environments for availability, performance, scalability, resilience, and cost, using infrastructure as code and automation wherever appropriate. support bids and pre-sales engagements by defining technical requirements, developing the target architecture, evaluating tco, and partnering with sales on the sow. make consequential architecture decisions under incomplete information or time pressure; document the rationale and revisit decisions when new evidence emerges. resolve the most complex production issues by reproducing failures, identifying root causes, and implementing durable improvements to performance and reliability. lead the technical response to high-severity incidents, from diagnosis and mitigation through verified resolution and follow-up corrective actions. build prototypes, load tests, failure reproductions, and diagnostic tools to validate assumptions and settle technical questions with evidence. define integrations and apis with product architecture and client teams, ensuring interoperability, resilience, security, and compatibility with existing environments. design and optimize database architecture, including performance, integrity, capacity planning, and secure schema migrations. establish sre, high-availability, and disaster-recovery practices, including slos, slas, recovery objectives, and measures to reduce mean time to recovery. strengthen application observability through logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and dashboards developed with monitoring, devops, sre, and r&d. design and automate ci/cd pipelines and deployment tooling to enable secure, repeatable, and reliable production releases. monitor production health through reliability and performance indicators, and assess delivery effectiveness using dora metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, and time to restore service. translate production findings into prioritized technical requirements for r&d, improving the product’s performance, reliability, observability, and deployability. embed security, privacy, and regulatory compliance into every architecture decision, particularly where health data is involved. establish client architecture standards, guide deployment, devops, and sre specialists, mentor technical colleagues, and influence cross-functional decisions without relying on formal authority. artificial intelligence partner with the ai lab to define and promote the responsible integration of ai and generative ai—including llms, retrieval-augmented generation, and orchestrated workflows—into client solutions and their supporting architecture. design ai-enabled operational capabilities such as anomaly detection, performance analysis, and intelligent automation, with appropriate security, privacy, governance, and human oversight. help technical teams use ai responsibly and effectively, critically assess ai-generated outputs, monitor emerging developments, and advise leadership on relevant opportunities and risks. qualifications what you bring a university degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. at least 10 years of experience in solution, systems, or infrastructure architecture within production environments, ideally in a multi-client or managed-services setting. demonstrated expertise in cloud and hybrid architecture, infrastructure as code, networking, and client-specific infrastructure design. strong knowledge of sre, high availability, disaster recovery, observability, performance engineering, and incident management. a track record of personally diagnosing and resolving complex production failures, including the ability to explain how the root cause was identified and what actions were taken during the critical first hour. fluency with diagnostic tools and techniques such as profilers, distributed tracing, packet capture, query plans, load testing, and operating-system-level investigation. a bias for action, supported by examples of delivering effective fixes, workarounds, or technical decisions in ambiguous and time-sensitive situations. strong knowledge of systems integration, apis, data architecture, database performance, migrations, and capacity planning. experience designing ci/cd pipelines, deployment automation, and infrastructure as code, as well as applying dora metrics to improve software delivery. experience incorporating security, privacy, and compliance requirements into architecture, ideally in healthcare or another regulated industry. sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance technical performance, reliability, delivery speed, risk, and tco. experience integrating ai or generative ai responsibly into solutions or operational processes is a strong asset. influential technical leadership, strong mentoring abilities, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning. excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical situations clearly and concisely to clients, executives, sales, and other non-technical audiences—particularly during live incidents. language requirement bilingualism (french and english) is mandatory, as the person will work with documentation and communicate with french- and english-speaking clients, partners, and colleagues. additional information why join lgi? a workplace built on trust, autonomy and collaboration the opportunity to grow, perform and work alongside curious and talented colleagues a continuous learning culture with dedicated training time, a renowed skills development platform and access to cutting-edge tools stimulating projects that advance healthcare technology and support the work of over 320,000 professionals, benefiting more than 6 million patients a comprehensive benefits package including group insurance from day one, a group rrsp with employer contributions, 24/7 telemedicine, an employee and family assistance program, and a minimum of 3 weeks vacation per year at lgi healthcare solutions, we value diversity and equal access to employment.

job descriptionjob descriptiondescription de l'entreprise medfar solutions cliniques a été fondée en 2010 par deux ingénieurs aéronautiques qui ont réalisé que les systèmes de santé n'exploitaient pas le plein potentiel de la technologie. soutenue par une vaste communauté d'experts médicaux et axée sur le succès des cliniques et la sécurité des patients, medfar a été la première entreprise à certifier un dossier médical électronique infonuagique au canada, myle (make your life easy). engagée à promouvoir l'excellence et l'efficacité des soins de santé dans le monde entier, medfar se différencie en offrant une solution de gestion de soins unique pour les cliniques, qui remplace les processus inefficaces par une alternative technologique plus rapide et plus sécuritaire. description du poste en tant que spécialiste senior cloud / devops, tu es responsable de la conception, de la mise en place et de la maintenance des infrastructures cloud et des solutions de plateforme, avec un haut niveau d’autonomie. tu prends des décisions techniques de manière indépendante, en veillant à ce que les systèmes soient évolutifs, sécurisés et alignés avec les standards de l’organisation ainsi qu’avec les objectifs sre. dans ce rôle, tu pilotes des projets complexes, contribues à l’amélioration des infrastructures, de l’observabilité et des processus opérationnels, et accompagnes les membres de l’équipe. tu collabores avec les architectes, les équipes produit et les parties prenantes afin de garantir que les solutions techniques répondent aux besoins métiers et opérationnels. responsabilités principales leadership en infrastructure : concevoir et maintenir de manière autonome des infrastructures cloud évolutives et sécurisées à l’aide d’infrastructure as code (iac). standardisation des plateformes : définir et faire évoluer les standards, lignes directrices et bonnes pratiques pour les déploiements cloud et les architectures. excellence en fiabilité : mettre en place le monitoring, les alertes, les tableaux de bord et les budgets d’erreur afin d’assurer la performance et la santé des systèmes. évaluation technique : analyser et conseiller sur de nouvelles technologies, options d’approvisionnement et propositions d’architecture en cohérence avec les objectifs sre. optimisation des ressources : analyser l’utilisation des ressources et mettre en œuvre des pratiques d’optimisation des coûts ainsi que des initiatives finops. mentorat : accompagner et soutenir les membres de l’équipe, en partageant les bonnes pratiques afin de renforcer les compétences techniques collectives. amélioration continue : identifier les lacunes dans les processus ou les outils et proposer des solutions concrètes pour améliorer l’efficacité de la plateforme. qualifications baccalauréat en informatique, technologies de l’information ou domaine connexe, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente 6+ ans d’expérience en infrastructure cloud, automatisation ou domaines techniques connexes expertise concrète avec des plateformes cloud (idéalement azure) et des outils d’infrastructure as code tels que terraform, terragrunt, helm, ansible, etc. expérience dans la conception et la mise en place de pipelines ci/cd, de workflows d’automatisation et de stratégies de déploiement pour des systèmes complexes solide compréhension des réseaux, du rbac, des bonnes pratiques de sécurité et des architectures cloud maîtrise d’outils d’observabilité tels que elk, azure monitor ou équivalents, ainsi que des pratiques d’excellence opérationnelle expérience avérée dans la mise en place de solutions de conteneurisation (docker) et d’orchestration (kubernetes, etc.) pour des systèmes complexes capacité à prendre des décisions techniques de manière autonome tout en conciliant dette technique et qualité des livrables maîtrise avancée de langages de script ou de programmation tels que powershell, .net ou équivalents excellentes compétences en collaboration et communication, en français et en anglais conditions de travail : poste permanent à temps plein (40 heures par semaine). modalités de travail flexibles, en mode hybride ou à distance. une présence occasionnelle au bureau peut être requise au cours de l’année. les candidats doivent résider dans la province de québec. informations supplémentaires ce que nous vous offrons: télétravail et flexibilité (équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée). contribution au reer assurance collective complète dès le premier jour. congé payé: 3 semaines + 1 entre noël et le nouvel an. allocation annuelle de formation pour soutenir votre développement professionnel. programme d'onboarding pour vous familiariser avec notre environnement et le domaine de la santé numérique le matériel informatique est fourni, ainsi que d’autres équipements si nécessaire. opportunités de croissance interne (promotions, mobilité interne) l’appui d’un comité bien-être et social , avec des initiatives favorisant la cohésion, la santé mentale et le bien-être de nos employés une culture d'entreprise axée sur la transparence, la collaboration et l'innovation. rejoindre un environnement dynamique et innovant, où votre travail a un impact concret et à grande échelle, en contribuant à moderniser les soins de santé tant au canada qu’à l’international. avec nos bureaux situés à travers le monde, la maîtrise du français et l'anglais est nécessaire chez medfar. en raison du besoin de communiquer avec des collègues et/ou des clients d'autres provinces ou pays, le bilinguisme nous permet de communiquer dans les deux langues tout en favorisant l'utilisation du français. chez medfar, nous valorisons la diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion au sein de notre équipe. nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement de travail où chaque individu se sent respecté et soutenu, quelle que soit son origine, son identité ou ses capacités. dans le cadre de notre engagement envers un processus de recrutement équitable et inclusif, nous offrons des mesures d’accommodement aux candidats qui en font la demande. en cas de besoin lors de votre entrevue, faites-le-nous savoir afin que nous puissions vous offrir une expérience adaptée. medfar a souscrit volontairement à un programme d'accès à l'égalité en emploi (paée). les candidatures des femmes, des minorités visibles, des minorités ethniques, l’égalité en emploi (paéé). l’auto-identification n’est pas obligatoire, mais peut vous permettre de bénéficier de mesures dans le cadre d’une embauche ou d’une promotion si vous possédez les compétences requises pour exercer l’emploi. pour mieux comprendre le processus d'auto-identification, vous pouvez consulter ce guide.

faire le lien entre la conception technique, la simulation, le développement unity et l’intégration de systèmes. en collaboration avec la gestion de produit et les experts du domaine, ce rôle pratique prend en charge la traduction des opérations réelles et des objectifs de formation en expériences de simulation intuitives et mesurables, tout en apportant la profondeur technique nécessaire pour créer des systèmes réutilisables, diagnostiquer des problèmes complexes et améliorer les flux de développement du contenu. conception technique et simulation concevoir et livrer dans unity des scénarios de formation interactifs et réalistes, en collaboration avec la gestion de produit et les experts du domaine pour définir l’expérience. prendre en charge des fonctionnalités et des scénarios de formation techniquement complexes, du concept initial et du prototypage jusqu’à l’implémentation, l’intégration, la validation et l’itération. traduire les opérations réelles, les objectifs de formation et les processus industriels en structure de scénario, interactions du stagiaire, rétroaction, logique d’évaluation, conditions de réussite ou d’échec et comportements attendus de formation. concevoir la logique des scénarios, les systèmes d’interaction, les machines à états, les événements de formation et les systèmes connexes nécessaires pour reproduire des opérations scénarios, des extensions de l’éditeur, des composants et des outils de soutien, plutôt que de s’appuyer uniquement sur des implémentations propres à une scène. appliquer de bonnes pratiques de structurée les problèmes complexes touchant le contenu unity, les scripts, les actifs, les interfaces de simulation, le comportement physique, les commandes et le matériel cible. intégrer le contenu de formation unity aux simulations physiques internes de vortex studio via les interfaces existantes pour états de simulation, événements, commandes et autres données pertinentes, en collaboration avec les développeurs logiciels. collaboration multidisciplinaire et mentorat agir comme pont technique entre les concepteurs techniques, les développeurs unity, les spécialistes en simulation, les artistes 3d, l’assurance qualité, la gestion de produit et les experts du domaine. traduire les contraintes multidisciplinaires en approches d’implémentation concrètes et communiquer clairement les décisions, compromis, dépendances, hypothèses et risques. encadrer les concepteurs techniques juniors et intermédiaires au moyen de conseils techniques, de revues d’implémentation, de travail en pair qualité du contenu au sein de l’équipe de conception. ce que vous apportez 5 ans ou plus d’expérience en conception technique, développement de gameplay, développement de simulation ou dans un domaine description: job description as a programming team lead (lead ai behavior systems) at ubisoft montreal, you will join a multidisciplinary team bringing together experts in data, programming, game design, narrative, and animation to explore the potential of generative ai in gameplay. you will contribute to the development of dynamic, immersive, and surprising game experiences by leading a team focused on ai behavior systems. working at the intersection of research and development, game creation, and cross-studio collaboration, you will help build the technologies behind the next generation of gameplay experiences. what you’ll do lead a multidisciplinary team composed of mlops specialists, data scientists, and ai programmers. prioritize, assign, and track team tasks based on deliverables and production goals. design hybrid behavior architectures combining reinforcement learning, imitation learning, generative ai, and traditional game ai approaches. define orchestration strategies between learned systems and deterministic systems. develop credible, controllable, and high-performing systems aligned with gameplay intentions. contribute to the design of machine learning deployment architectures, including online learning approaches. drive scientific monitoring and applied research activities related to decision-making and learning systems. collaborate with gameplay, design, and production teams to support adoption of developed solutions. mentor and support team members in their technical and professional growth. participate in recruitment, onboarding, and performance follow-ups for team members.

job_title: développeur front-end, marketing web / frontend developer, marketing web
description:
job descriptionjob description:

chez explorance, nous croyons que chaque expérience compte. nos solutions aident les organisations à recueillir des commentaires pertinents, à découvrir des informations exploitables et à favoriser l'amélioration continue. dans le cadre de notre expansion numérique, nous recherchons un développeur front-end passionné et techniquement compétent, spécialisé en expérience web marketing, pour prendre en charge et faire évoluer notre site web institutionnel.
 
ce poste est idéal pour une personne qui aime allier le développement front-end moderne au marketing numérique, à l'expérience utilisateur, au référencement naturel (seo) et à l'optimisation pour la recherche par ia. vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes marketing, design, marketing produit et marque afin de proposer des expériences numériques exceptionnelles qui captivent les visiteurs, génèrent de la demande et renforcent la marque explorance.

il s'agit d'un poste à temps plein, basé dans nos bureaux de montréal.
 
votre rôle 
en tant que développeur front-end responsable du site web d'explorance, vous assurerez la mise en œuvre technique, la performance et l'évolution continue de notre site web marketing. vous veillerez à ce que notre présence en ligne soit rapide, évolutive, accessible et optimisée pour les moteurs de recherche traditionnels et les expériences de recherche basées sur l'ia. vous serez l'expert technique responsable de la maintenance et de l'amélioration de notre cms strapi, de la création de composants frontend réutilisables, du soutien aux campagnes marketing et de l'amélioration continue des performances et de la visibilité du site web.
 
principales responsabilités

assurer le développement, la maintenance et l'amélioration continue du site web institutionnel d'explorance.
gérer et optimiser l'intégration entre le frontend du site web et le cms strapi.
concevoir et développer des composants frontend réutilisables, évolutifs et responsifs à l'aide des technologies web modernes.
collaborer étroitement avec les équipes marketing, design et marketing produit pour la création de landing pages, d'expériences de campagne, de lancements de produits et d'améliorations du site web.
transformer les maquettes figma en expériences web de haute qualité, prêtes pour la production. garantir une expérience utilisateur exceptionnelle sur ordinateur et appareils mobiles.
optimiser la vitesse, l'accessibilité, les core web vitals et les performances techniques globales du site web.
mettre en œuvre et maintenir les bonnes pratiques de référencement technique (seo), notamment les métadonnées, les données structurées (schema.org), le maillage interne, les sitemaps, la canonicalisation, l'exploration et l'indexation. • améliorer la visibilité du site web sur les moteurs de recherche traditionnels et les plateformes de recherche et de réponse basées sur l'ia (telles que chatgpt, gemini, claude, perplexity et autres solutions d'ia émergentes) en appliquant les meilleures pratiques d'optimisation pour l'ia et de structuration du contenu.
suivre les statistiques du site web, les performances seo, le trafic issu de l'ia et le comportement des utilisateurs afin d'améliorer en continu l'engagement et les conversions.
collaborer avec les équipes contenu et marketing pour concevoir des modèles de contenu et des processus de publication évolutifs au sein de strapi.
garantir des standards élevés en matière de qualité du code, de tests, de documentation et d'amélioration continue.
se tenir informé(e) des évolutions des technologies front-end, des tendances seo et des meilleures pratiques de recherche ia.

 
qualifications requises

plus de 4 ans d'expérience professionnelle en développement web front-end.
excellente maîtrise de html5, css3, javascript et typescript.
solide expérience avec react et/ou next.js.
expérience pratique de strapi cms, notamment en modélisation de contenu, intégration d'api, gestion des permissions utilisateurs et processus de gestion de contenu. • excellente compréhension du responsive design, de l'accessibilité (wcag) et de l'architecture front-end moderne.
expérience en optimisation des performances web, des core web vitals et de la vitesse de chargement des pages.
solides connaissances en seo technique, notamment en données structurées (schema.org), sitemaps xml, robots.txt, url canoniques, optimisation des métadonnées et maillage interne.
expérience avec google analytics 4, google search console, google tag manager, ahrefs, semrush ou des plateformes d'analyse et de seo similaires.
maîtrise de git et des workflows ci/cd modernes.
excellentes aptitudes à la communication et à la collaboration.

 
atouts

expérience avec les sites web multilingues.
expérience en implémentation de systèmes de conception.
connaissance de l'optimisation du taux de conversion (cro) et des tests a/b.
expérience en intégration de technologies marketing telles que hubspot, marketo ou des plateformes similaires.
expérience avec les audits d'accessibilité et les outils de suivi des performances. • maîtrise de l'optimisation pour les moteurs de recherche (geo) et des stratégies visant à améliorer la visibilité et la citation du contenu sur les plateformes de recherche et conversationnelles basées sur l'ia.

 
pourquoi rejoindre explorance ?
vous aurez l'opportunité de façonner la présence numérique d'une entreprise saas internationale et d'influencer directement la manière dont les clients découvrent nos solutions, interagissent avec elles et s'y informent. si vous êtes passionné(e) par la création d'expériences web exceptionnelles et souhaitez rester à la pointe du seo, de la visibilité grâce à l'ia et des technologies front-end modernes, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer.

autres exigences
ne postulez que si vous résidez à montréal (ou dans les environs) et que vous souhaitez faire partie d’une culture dynamique et très engagée au bureau.
 
chez explorance, nous prenons l’inclusion à cœur et la vivons chaque jour. nous mettons l’humain au premier plan dans tout ce que nous faisons et sommes fiers de notre authenticité et de notre culture de l’inclusion. nous encourageons donc les personnes de toute race, religion, ethnie, identité de genre, orientation sexuelle, âge, statut d’immigration, handicap ou autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi à postuler. nous prenons nos décisions en matière d’emploi sans tenir compte de ces caractéristiques. et pour garantir un espace de travail sûr à tous nos employés, tout emploi est subordonné à la réception d’une vérification satisfaisante des antécédents et des références.
 
à propos d’exploranceexplorance permet aux organisations de disposer d’analytique de données au service du feedback organisationnel nouvelle génération afin d’accélérer la transition de l’information à l’action, encourageant ainsi la philosophie du « feedback for the brave » pour stimuler l’objectif, l’impact, et la croissance.
forte de ses 20 ans d’expertise, explorance, membre du forum économique mondial et partenaire de confiance de 35 % des entreprises du fortune 100 et de 25 % des meilleurs établissements d’enseignement supérieur au monde, a influencé plus de 25 millions de personnes grâce à des solutions primées telles que blue, metrics that matter, et mly.constamment parmi les meilleurs employeurs selon le great places to work institute®, explorance, lauréat du prix brandon hall ai, est également deux fois leader mondial sur le marché du feedback à 360 degrés selon fortune business insights.
pour plus d’informations, visitez explorance.com ou contactez-nous sur linkedin, facebook et x.
 
***
at explorance, we believe every experience matters. our solutions help organizations collect meaningful feedback, uncover actionable insights, and drive continuous improvement. as we continue to expand our digital presence, we’re looking for a passionate and technically strong frontend developer, marketing web experience to own and evolve our corporate website.
this role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining modern frontend development with digital marketing, user experience, seo, and emerging ai search optimization. you’ll work closely with marketing, design, product marketing, and brand teams to deliver exceptional digital experiences that engage visitors, generate demand, and strengthen the explorance brand.

this is a full-time, on-site position based in our montreal office.

your role
as the frontend developer responsible for the explorance website, you will own the technical implementation, performance, and continuous evolution of our marketing website. you will ensure our web presence is fast, scalable, accessible, and optimized for both traditional search engines and ai-powered search experiences.
you’ll be the technical expert responsible for maintaining and enhancing our strapi cms, building reusable frontend components, supporting marketing campaigns, and continuously improving website performance and discoverability.

key responsibilities

own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the explorance corporate website.
manage and optimize the integration between the website frontend and strapi cms.
design and develop reusable, scalable, and responsive frontend components using modern web technologies.
collaborate closely with marketing, design, and product marketing to deliver landing pages, campaign experiences, product launches, and website enhancements.
translate figma designs into high-quality, production-ready web experiences.
ensure the website delivers an exceptional user experience across desktop and mobile devices.
optimize website speed, accessibility, core web vitals, and overall technical performance.
implement and maintain technical seo best practices, including metadata, structured data (schema.org), internal linking, sitemaps, canonicalization, crawlability, and indexing.
improve the website’s visibility across both traditional search engines and ai-powered search and answer platforms (such as chatgpt, gemini, claude, perplexity, and other emerging ai experiences) by applying best practices for ai discoverability and structured content.
monitor website analytics, seo performance, ai referral traffic, and user behavior to continuously improve engagement and conversions.
partner with content and marketing teams to build scalable content models and publishing workflows within strapi.
maintain high standards for code quality, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement.
stay current with evolving frontend technologies, seo trends, and ai search best practices.

 
required qualifications

4+ years of professional frontend web development experience.
strong proficiency in html5, css3, javascript, and typescript.
solid experience with react and/or js.
hands-on experience with strapi cms, including content modeling, api integration, user permissions, and content management workflows.
strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility (wcag), and modern frontend architecture.
experience optimizing website performance, core web vitals, and page speed.
strong knowledge of technical seo, including structured data (schema.org), xml sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical urls, metadata optimization, and internal linking.
experience using google analytics 4, google search console, google tag manager, ahrefs, semrush, or similar analytics and seo platforms.
familiarity with git and modern ci/cd workflows.
strong communication and collaboration skills.

 
nice to have

experience with multilingual websites.
experience implementing design systems.
knowledge of conversion rate optimization (cro) and a/b testing.
experience integrating marketing technologies such as hubspot, marketo, or similar platforms.
experience with accessibility audits and performance monitoring tools.
understanding of generative engine optimization (geo) and strategies that improve content visibility and citation in ai-powered search and conversational platforms.

why join explorance?
you’ll have the opportunity to shape the digital presence of a global saas company and directly influence how customers discover, engage with, and learn about our solutions. if you’re passionate about building exceptional web experiences and staying at the forefront of seo, ai discoverability, and modern frontend technologies, we’d love to meet you.
 
other requirements
only apply if you are a montreal (or surroundings) resident that is interested in being part of a vibrant and highly engaged at-the-office culture. 
 
at explorance, we take inclusion to heart and live it each day. we put the ‘human’ first in everything we do and take pride in our authenticity and culture of inclusion. we therefore encourage persons of any race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, immigration status, disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics to apply. we make employment-related decisions without regard to any of these characteristics. and to ensure a safe workspace for all our employees, all employment is contingent upon receipt of a satisfactory background and reference check.
 
about explorance
explorance empowers organizations with next-generation feedback analytics to accelerate the insight-to-action cycle, encouraging the philosophy of “feedback for the brave” to drive purpose, impact, and growth.
bringing 20 years of expertise, explorance, a member of the world economic forum and a trusted partner for 35% of fortune 100 companies and 25% of the world’s top higher education institutions, has influenced over 25 million individuals with award-winning solutions like blue, metrics that matter, and mly.consistently among the top employers by the great places to work institute®, explorance, a brandon hall ai award winner, is also a two-time global leader in the 360-degree feedback market by fortune business insights.

complex problems. excellent collaboration and communication skills, enabling effective work with developers, tech leads, and other members of core tech.

leader with experience selling enterprise software to the manufacturing industry: strong hands-on sales leader that is excited to crack the code of selling a transformative ai technology to manufacturers. sales leader with proven track record selling enterprise software to manufacturers, with a proven track record starting from $0 and growing to $10m+ in arr experience hiring, developing, retaining and leading high-performing sales staff you’ve personally driven enterprise sales opportunities from prospecting to close, while building relationships with all relevant stakeholders including legal, privacy, procurement, it, business and production. you’ve had experience leading marketing activities (nice-to-have) what you’ll get a meaningful equity stake in testing, monitoring, patching, troubleshooting — while staying connected to the bigger picture: the infrastructure roadmap the it team is building together. that means you need to be as comfortable in already figured out. we're a manufacturing company that moves fast and evolves constantly — some of our processes are mature, some are still being defined, and you'll have a hand in shaping both. if a job description is this the right fit? worth being upfront about how we work: we're looking for someone still close to the technology. you'll spend most of your time leading, but you should be able to get into the details with your team and know what you're looking at. not everything here is documented. some of our processes are mature, some aren't. you'll be improving both, and that requires comfort with a certain amount of ambiguity. we value decisions over consensus-building. you'll have the authority to make calls in your area. we'd rather you make them and keep us informed than wait for a committee. we care about outcomes more than reporting on them. good metrics matter, but the goal is fewer outages and faster recovery — not better dashboards about them. if a fully stable, fully documented environment is where you do your best work, this probably isn't the right move. if you'd rather build the structure than inherit it, keep reading. what you'll own your team. technicians across two countries. you'll handle hiring, onboarding, coaching, and performance — including the harder conversations. the goal is a team that holds a high standard because it's clearly set and genuinely supported, and where nobody is the only person who knows how something works. support that works. helpdesk, field support, and the 6 am call from a plant that's down. you'll own the end-to-end support experience: triaging what gets escalated, what gets solved immediately, and making sure the people who depend on technology don't feel it when something goes wrong. security operations. identity and access, conditional access and mfa, endpoint hardening, patch and vulnerability management, email threat response. the director sets strategy; the operational execution is yours. manufacturing is a target, so when something does land, you're leading the response. assets, procurement, and vendor contracts. you'll own the it inventory — hardware, software, and licensing — and keep it accurate enough to make real decisions from. that extends to procurement: specifying what we buy, running quotes and rfps, and standardizing the fleet instead of accumulating one-offs. you'll also manage our vendor and service contracts, which means tracking renewals before they surprise us, negotiating terms, and being willing to push back on a supplier when the value isn't there. improvement and projects. you'll notice when the same ticket keeps coming back and address the cause rather than getting faster at closing it. site upgrades, rollouts, and migrations — you'll scope them and see them through. you'll also look for practical ways to put ai to work in your team's workflow, where it genuinely makes them faster. what success looks like in the first year response and resolution times measurably improved, with data behind it a security posture you'd be comfortable walking an auditor or insurer through: patch compliance, mfa coverage, tested restores, a documented incident process no single points of failure on the team — including you an it inventory and contract calendar we can actually plan and budget from a few chronic, recurring problems permanently resolved documentation that exists because it was worth building

description: à propos du poste nous recherchons un(e) ingénieur(e) logiciel sénior passionné(e) par la conception de logiciels capables de transformer d'importants volumes de données transactionnelles en modèles métier intelligents. il ne s'agit pas d'un poste traditionnel en ingénierie des données. bien que nous traitions des centaines de millions de transactions financières, notre objectif ne consiste pas uniquement à déplacer ou transformer des données. nous développons des logiciels capables de comprendre les comportements financiers. notre unité de raisonnement est le membre individuel, et non une table ou un ensemble de données. nous concevons des modèles métier riches représentant les personnes, leurs produits financiers, leurs comportements, leurs relations et leur situation financière. ces abstractions alimentent des fonctionnalités intelligentes destinées à améliorer l'expérience utilisateur. si vous aimez concevoir des logiciels qui modélisent le monde réel plutôt que simplement manipuler des données, ce poste est pour vous. responsabilités concevoir et faire évoluer des modèles objets riches représentant des concepts financiers complexes. transformer des transactions financières brutes en abstractions utiles telles que des abonnements, paiements récurrents, commerçants, produits financiers et caractéristiques comportementales. développer des logiciels évolutifs capables de traiter des centaines de millions de transactions. collaborer avec les équipes produit, données et développement afin de modéliser des concepts financiers complexes. concevoir des architectures logicielles extensibles, maintenables et évolutives. concilier une conception logicielle de qualité avec les exigences du traitement massif de données. contribuer à l'évolution de notre plateforme d'intelligence financière. profil recherché exigences solides bases en développement logiciel. excellente maîtrise de la conception orientée objet et de la modélisation métier. capacité à concevoir des objets riches en comportement plutôt que de simples représentations de données. excellentes aptitudes en résolution de problèmes. curiosité pour les domaines techniques, financiers et comportementaux. capacité à évoluer dans des environnements complexes et ambigus. expérience en python ou volonté d'en faire votre principal langage de développement. expérience en conception de systèmes logiciels évolutifs. atouts expérience avec apache airflow. expérience avec aws. expérience dans le traitement de grands volumes de données. connaissance du domain-driven design (ddd). expérience en fintech, services financiers, personnalisation, moteurs de recommandation, détection de fraude ou domaines similaires. ce qui vous distingue vous aimez comprendre la signification des données plutôt que simplement les transformer. vous vous posez naturellement des questions telles que : que représente réellement cette information? quel concept métier doit être modélisé? quel comportement appartient à cet objet? quelles preuves soutiennent cette interprétation? comment ce modèle pourra-t-il évoluer dans le temps? vous prenez autant de plaisir à concevoir une architecture logicielle robuste qu'à écrire du code de qualité. pourquoi nous rejoindre vous participerez à la conception d'une plateforme d'intelligence financière où l'architecture logicielle, la modélisation métier et le traitement de données à grande échelle se rencontrent pour créer des produits innovants. about the role we are looking for a senior software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems by transforming large volumes of transactional data into meaningful domain models. this is not a traditional data engineering role. while we process hundreds of millions of financial transactions, our focus is not simply moving or transforming data. we build software that understands financial behaviour. our fundamental unit of reasoning is the individual member—not a table or a dataset. we design rich domain models that represent people, their financial products, behaviours, relationships, and evolving circumstances. these abstractions enable intelligent financial insights and support future product capabilities. if you enjoy designing software that models the real world, rather than simply manipulating data, we'd like to meet you. what you'll do design and evolve rich object models that represent financial concepts and user behaviour. transform raw financial transactions into meaningful abstractions such as subscriptions, recurring payments, merchants, financial products, behavioural traits, and user insights. build scalable software capable of processing hundreds of millions of financial transactions while preserving clean domain abstractions. work closely with product, data, and engineering teams to model complex financial concepts. design software that is extensible, maintainable, and evolves as our understanding of the domain grows. balance elegant software design with the realities of large-scale data processing. continuously improve the architecture of our financial intelligence platform. what we're looking for required strong software engineering fundamentals. excellent object-oriented design and domain modelling skills. ability to design behaviour-rich objects rather than simply representing database records. strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. curiosity to understand technical, financial, and behavioural domains. ability to reason through complex systems and ambiguous requirements. python experience or a strong willingness to use python as your primary development language. experience designing scalable software systems. nice to have experience with apache airflow. experience with aws. experience working with large-scale data processing. knowledge of domain-driven design (ddd). experience in financial services, fintech, recommendation systems, personalization, fraud detection, or similar complex domains. what success looks like you naturally ask questions like: what does this data represent? what concepts should exist in the domain? what behaviour belongs inside each object? what evidence supports this conclusion? how will this model evolve as new products and rules emerge? you enjoy modelling complex business concepts as much as writing production-quality code. why join us you'll work on technically challenging problems at the intersection of software engineering, financial intelligence, and large-scale data processing. you'll have significant influence on the architecture of a platform designed to help people better understand their financial lives. powered by jazzhr

job_title: digital marketing intern - seo & ai search
description: search is being rewritten. come help us shape what's next. buyers used to start on google. now they ask chatgpt, claude, perplexity, and gemini which vendors to trust. getting recommended by an ai assistant is a different problem from ranking on a search page — some people call it generative engine optimization (geo), some call it aeo, and the field hasn't agreed on a name yet. that's how early this is. at flexspring — the leading expert in hr data integration — we're investing in it now rather than waiting for the playbook to be written. you'll work directly with our vp of marketing and seo specialist across both halves of the job: the seo discipline that's thirty years old and well understood, and the ai-search side that's about two years old and largely unmapped. you'll run experiments, analyze results, and help build our approach. you'll own real projects and leave with a portfolio that shows measurable business impact. what you'll do run keyword research and build the topic clusters and content roadmap that come out of it figure out what actually makes ai assistants cite a company as a source — and apply it to us track how we appear in google, ai overviews, chatgpt, claude, perplexity, and gemini handle on-page optimization and support technical seo audits support backlink outreach and digital pr across hr tech and enterprise software publications use ai tools to accelerate research, competitive analysis, and reporting analyze rankings, traffic, and ai citations to recommend what we do next what you'll walk away with a full audit covering both traditional search and ai visibility for a real ipaas company. a keyword strategy and content architecture you built. technical recommendations backed by your own research. practical experience measuring how a brand shows up inside ai assistants — something very few marketers can claim yet. what we're looking for this is a new field. there's no textbook and no established playbook, so we're screening for evidence you move first rather than wait for instructions. you've used ai tools to do something nobody assigned you — automated a workflow, run an experiment, built a small tool, tested how an llm answers questions in a space you care about. tell us what you tried and what happened, including the parts that failed. you can read data and find the story in it — rankings, traffic, citations, whatever the numbers are you write clearly and catch details — this work is judged on precision you form opinions and say them out loud — we want someone who'll tell us kits, application frameworks, libraries, reference architectures and solution templates that can be adapted across multiple enterprise use cases. you will not be responsible for designing isolated features or single-purpose applications. you will engineer complete systems by understanding business requirements, performance expectations, user volumes, integration constraints, tenancy models, security requirements and operational behaviour. the ideal candidate has a proven track record of designing and delivering complex enterprise solutions while remaining close to the code. what will you build you will contribute to the design and development of: enterprise-grade artificial intelligence platforms and solutions multi-tenant software architectures reusable sdks, libraries and engineering frameworks application templates and reference implementations ai-enabled enterprise applications modular product components that can be assembled into broader solutions integration layers connecting existing platforms, services and applications scalable backend services and distributed systems high-level and detailed system architecture artefacts proofs of concept that can be industrialised into production-grade products key responsibilities systems design & architecture own the high-level design of scalable, secure and maintainable enterprise systems. translate complex business and technical requirements into clearly defined system architectures. design systems based on expected user volumes, performance requirements, data throughput, concurrency, availability and operational constraints. define system boundaries, component responsibilities, service interactions, data flows, interfaces and integration patterns. design architectures capable of supporting a minimum of 1,000 users while maintaining reliability, performance and scalability. evaluate architectural trade-offs across performance, cost, maintainability, security and speed of delivery. develop reference architectures and reusable design patterns for enterprise ai solutions. create architecture documentation, technical specifications, system diagrams and design decision records. enterprise ai solution engineering design enterprise ai solutions that combine models, sdks, applications, apis, data platforms and existing enterprise systems. determine how existing technologies and applications can be integrated and orchestrated into a unified solution. architect systems supporting ai inference, intelligent automation, agentic workflows, retrieval, data processing and enterprise integrations. design reusable ai solution components rather than one-off implementations. ensure ai systems are production-ready, observable, secure and capable of operating at enterprise scale. collaborate with ai, machine learning, product and platform teams to convert experimental capabilities into reliable software products. hands-on software engineering remain directly involved in coding, prototyping and technical implementation. build backend services, apis, libraries, sdks, system components and reusable engineering tools. produce clean, efficient, tested and maintainable production code. prototype complex architectural concepts to validate feasibility, performance and integration behaviour. review code and guide engineering teams on system-level implementation decisions. diagnose performance bottlenecks, architectural limitations and system-level failures. work across multiple programming languages and choose technologies based on system requirements rather strategies for shared and dedicated infrastructure across different enterprise customers. design systems that can scale horizontally and vertically based on workload patterns. understand the performance, capacity, limitations and ideal use cases of each system component. establish approaches for load distribution, caching, asynchronous processing, resilience and fault tolerance. design for high availability, graceful degradation, recoverability and operational continuity. anticipate future scale and prevent architectural decisions that create long-term platform limitations.
